live.obsObsSetupFields: Service: Custom · Server = URL below · Stream key = key (do not append key to the URL). Do not use OBS Auto-Configuration Wizard (Twitch/YouTube only).
live.obsOutputFields: Advanced mode · x264 encoder · AAC · CBR 2500 Kbps · Keyframes 2 s (not auto) · Baseline profile · x264 options: bframes=0 keyint=60 min-keyint=60. Disconnect loop? Try RTMPS (uncheck RTMP fallback) or vice versa.
live.obsStreamKeyPersistent: This key is unique to your Soundy account. Paste it once in OBS — it stays valid for future lives.
live.obsKeySuffixHint: In OBS, the stream key must end with: {{suffix}}
live.obsStreamQuotaZero: Cloudflare Stream RTMP ingest is disabled on this account (0 min quota). Cloudflare Dashboard → Stream → enable Stream Live billing. Until quota > 0, OBS connects then drops (error 10053) — not an OBS settings issue.

live.obsRepairError: Could not repair the RTMP stream.

live.obsRtmpFallbackHint: Recommended if RTMPS disconnects — rtmp://live.cloudflare.com:1935/live/ with the same key (checked by default).
live.obsStep3: Output: H.264 + AAC, 2 s GOP, ≤ 6 Mbps.
live.obsStep4: Start the Soundy live, then « Start Streaming » in OBS.
live.obsConnectTrouble: OBS log: « Connection successful (2a06:98c1:…) » then 10053/10054? OBS is using IPv6 (even with RTMP fallback). Settings → Advanced → Network: Bind to IP = your Wi‑Fi 192.168.x.x (not Default) + IP family « IPv4 only ». Confirm the OBS key ends with k + the ID above. Disable Killer Intelligence / Advanced Stream Detect. Restart OBS after changes.
